notes: The former 3903-3905 14th Street NW Chicatana/Toast catalog is a different historical location and is excluded.
POC catalog and every frozen item were coordinator-reconciled.
All four official-matrix search classes completed; direct positives are retained and missing disclosure remains unavailable.
POC closeout uses a verified target-specific catalog transformation; shared-parser review is deferred.
Coordinator terminal catalog derived from validated Luna research and serialized APPLY output.

adjudication.rationale: Research structure, current product mappings, direct allergen authority, target repair, Ingredient Intelligence timing, focused validation, and idempotency passed the POC terminal gates.

evidence.excerpt: Complete current restaurant-controlled Owner ordering menu: 67 unique food and nonalcoholic products across nine categories, with explicit descriptions on selected items.
Current one-page Chicatana happy-hour menu. It adds Fried Quesadillas and supplies explicit ingredients for repeated starters and tacos; no allergen matrix or cross-contact statement.
Current brunch drink menu is alcoholic except Cafe de Olla, already consolidated with the ordering-menu product.
Current happy-hour page states Monday-Friday 4-6 PM and embeds the restaurant-issued happy-hour PDF.
Official drinks hub embeds current drink, brunch drink, tequila, and mezcal PDFs.
Current official homepage identifies Chicatana at 1400 Meridian Pl NW, Washington, DC 20010.
